title: Vintage Gibson J-45 Value Guide: Prices Through 1979
description: Vintage Gibson J-45 values from 1942 through 1979, with annual price references, repair and originality context, and photographs from my guitar archive.
alt: Sunburst J-45 with a large mottled pickguard lying in a brown case

faqs.q: How Much Is A 1950s Gibson J-45 Worth?
faqs.a: The 1955 to 1959 range is $7,500 to $10,000 for excellent guitars with original parts and the original case. Earlier 1950s guitars fall within the broader 1946 to 1954 range of $8,500 to $14,500. Repairs and changes need an individual appraisal.

faqs.q: What Is A 1970s J-45 Deluxe Worth?
faqs.a: The 1970 to 1979 range is $2,250 to $3,000 for an excellent original example with its original case. High action, repairs or changed parts need a separate assessment. Adjacent years share that broad range.

faqs.q: Does A Banner Logo Automatically Mean The Highest Value?
faqs.a: No. The Banner range covers different wood configurations, and the guitar's repairs and original parts still need examination. A decal alone doesn't establish its construction, condition or value.

faqs.q: Can I Use This Table For A J-50 Or Southern Jumbo?
faqs.a: No. Those are separate model categories. The comparison photographs show family differences, but the price table is for the J-45. I don't assign an automatic premium or discount to another model based on its finish or trim.

faqs.q: Does A Neck Reset Have A Fixed Percentage Deduction?
faqs.a: No. I consider the quality of the work, the resulting setup and any related changes. A documented reset and a guitar that still needs one are different conditions. This page doesn't apply an unsupported blanket percentage.

faqs.q: Will A Quality Refret Make My Guitar Nonoriginal?
faqs.a: Under this site's grading approach, a quality refret preserves the all-original classification of an otherwise original guitar, while removing museum-quality status. Neck reshaping, a replacement bridge or structural repair is a separate issue.

faqs.q: Are These Prices My Guaranteed Selling Proceeds?
faqs.a: No. They are dated condition-specific references. A direct purchase offer, a dealer asking price and the amount an owner receives after selling expenses are different figures. I need the actual guitar's details before making an offer.
